# BEAR.Security

> Security scanner for BEAR.Sunday applications with OWASP Top 10 compliance

## Overview

BEAR.Security is a PHP security vulnerability scanner designed for BEAR.Sunday framework applications. It provides both static (SAST) and dynamic (DAST) application security testing with 100% OWASP Top 10 coverage.

## Quick Start

```bash
composer require --dev bear/security
vendor/bin/bear.security-scan src
```

## Key Features

- 10 SAST detectors (SQL Injection, XSS, Command Injection, etc.)
- DAST with Security Headers analysis
- OWASP Top 10 checklist reports
- SARIF output for GitHub Security integration
- Psalm taint analysis enabled

- README: /README.md
